thread:
natalie (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize the staged retirement process for older catalog models. Goal: predictable customer migration path + minimal regressions. Thoughts on lanes and timing? :wave:

samir (ML): +1. We should tie deprecations to benchmark windows (quality + latency) and have an opt-in migration lane first.

aj (Eng): Technical constraints: some legacy model formats require adapter work. For Dedicated customers we need a config migration tool. Team estimate: ~2w for a lightweight converter.

marco (SE): Sales/CS feedback — customers want a clear opt-in window and a credit/incentive if migration causes measurable lift loss. They also want a 'hold pin' for 30d if they hit issues.

ryan (Sales): Echo Marco. Enterprise customers will push for exceptions. We should codify exception criteria + SLA impact.

natalie (PM): Proposal: three lanes — 1) Opt-in canary (30 days) 2) Soft retirement (60 days) with support/credits 3) Hard swap (after 120 days) + forced pin removal. Pin TTLs default = 90d but negotiable. Anyone opposed?

samir (ML): Sounds reasonable. Benchmarks: require eval-suite pass rate >= 98% of baseline (top-level metric) OR absolute quality delta <= 1.0% on primary metric. Latency P95 must be <= 1.1x baseline or <=220ms (whichever stricter).

aj (Eng): Ops note: for runtime compatibility we need auto-fallback to verified variant if customers hit increased errors. Also add a safety circuit: if 5%+ errors in 15m, auto-roll back.

marco (SE): Customer communication plan: pre-notice 45d, migration playbook + runbook shared during opt-in, weekly check-ins during soft retire. Provide migration checklist.

natalie (PM): Putting policy into one-liner + snippet for docs. Please review.

natalie (PM): ```
policy: {
  lanes: [
    {name: "opt_in_canary", window_days: 30, incentives: ["credits", "priority-support"]},
    {name: "soft_retirement", window_days: 60, incentives: ["migration-assist", "extended-pin-30d"]},
    {name: "hard_swap", window_days: 120, actions: ["force-swap", "deprecate-model"]}
  ],
  pin_default_ttl_days: 90,
  benchmark_thresholds: {quality_pct_of_baseline: 98, quality_abs_delta_pct: 1.0, latency_p95_multiplier: 1.1, latency_ms_cap: 220}
}
```

aj (Eng): That JSON-ish snippet is helpful. A couple notes: make the TTL a per-tenant override flag in the console, and expose a migration status endpoint `/v1/catalog/migrations/:tenant`.

samir (ML): We'll prepare an eval snapshot for the affected models and run drift checks daily during opt-in. Also recommend a small human review gate for customer-critical outputs.

ryan (Sales): One more ask — add a "customer pause" button for large enterprise legal/validation holdouts. Keeps them happy.

ops-bot: Incident check — no open infra blockers for staged retirements in `prod` clusters. :white_check_mark:

natalie (PM): Action items:
- samir: generate eval snapshot + pass/fail script (due EOD Thu)
- aj: spec migration API + console toggle (PR by next Wed)
- marco: draft comms + playbook (first draft Fri)
- ryan: list customers that will need exception lanes (share by Mon)

natalie (PM): If no objections, I'll add this to the roadmap slice for Q3 and file the RFC. Thanks everyone. :tada:
